Mozilla PDF.js 6.5.438, from the published pdfjs-dist npm package.
https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/examples/

Bundled: minified display library and worker, standard fonts and their licenses.
Original Apache 2.0 license retained in LICENSE. No remote runtime requests.
The archive viewer disables eval and WebAssembly, and renders one page at a time.
